texts.facts: Declare that the respondents 5 to 37 have no right to conduct the retail business of fish in the Sakthan Thamburan non-vegetarian market, Thrissur as they are not holding the license under the Food Safety and Standards Act 2006. vi. Direct the municipality and police authorities to ensure that the fish business in the Sakthan Thamburan non-vegetarian market is being strictly in accordance with Ext.P5 agreement. ii. Direct 1st and 2nd respondents, to take appropriate action to revoke the licenses granted to respondents 4 to 33 for doing retail fish trade in the passage, varanda, open yard etc. in violation of license conditions. WP(C) NO. 16803 OF 2014 & 11570 OF 2015 iii. Direct respondents 1 to 3 to ensure that the retail fish business in the Sakthan Thamburan non- vegetarian market is conducted strictly in accordance with the license conditions. 3. The main grievance of the petitioners is that the petitioners are wholesale businessman and the contesting respondents are doing business in violation of the licence condition and they are only retail fish vendors. It is also submitted that there was an understanding between the petitioners and the contesting respondents in the presence of the Corporation authorities and the same is violated by the contesting respondents.
